description: This file defines the backend code for the 'Edit Catalog Item' Razor Page, handling authorization, binding a catalog item view model, and managing get and post requests for editing catalog items.

classes.name: EditCatalogItemModel
classes.description: PageModel class for editing catalog items, with properties and methods to handle get and post requests, and authorization.

methods.name: EditCatalogItemModel
methods.description: Constructor that injects the catalog item service.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Initializes the page model with the catalog item to be edited.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles the form submission to update the catalog item if the model state is valid.
